exposure: delivery factor with potential to increase risk for levator ani muscle injury
cohort: 611 nulliparous women after their first vaginal birth
finding: Early postpartum moderate to vigorous physical activity was either protective or had no effect on parameters of pelvic floor health, except for support, which was worse in women with moderately high levels of activity.
mod_finding: This study found that in women after their first vaginal delivery, moderate to high levels of physical activity in the early postpartum period were associated with worse vaginal support, but that early postpartum moderate to vigorous physical activity was either protective or had no effect on other parameters of pelvic floor health.
